sentences.text:
Mennuddin Alias Meenu Bhati vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on
18 December, 2023

Author: Pankaj Bhatia
Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:239768
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 37585 of 2023
Applicant :- Mennuddin Alias Meenu Bhati
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Sunita Chauhan,Rahul Srivastava

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard Sri Deo Raj Singh holding brief of Ms. Sunita Chauhan, learned Counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
No one appears for the informant despite notice.
2. This is the second bail application.
The first bail application was rejected by this Court vide order dated 27.05.2022.

3. The contention of the Counsel for the applicant is that after rejection of the first bail application,
the informant is not co-operating with the trial as is evident from the order-sheet, which indicates that even notices have been issued to the informant for cross-examination, however, he is not Mennuddin Alias Meenu Bhati vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111532711/
1 co-operating.

entities.text: Mennuddin Alias Meenu Bhati vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. The Counsel for the applicant further argues that in terms of the mandate of Section 35 (2) of the POCSO Act, the Special Court shall conclude the trial within a period of one year from the date of cognizance of the offence.
In the present case, the cognizance of the offence is taken on 31.05.2021 and despite more than two years having elapsed, there is no likelihood of the trial being concluded in near future.
The applicant is in custody since 03.04.2021 and has no criminal antecedents.

5. Considering the manner in which the informant is not co-operating with the trial, as is evident from the order-sheet; the mandate of Section 35 of the POCSO Act; the applicant is in custody since 03.04.2021 and has no criminal antecedents, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Mennuddin alias Meenu Bhati be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.0465 of 2020, under Sections 363, 323, 342, 376, 506 IPC and Section 3/ 4 of the POCSO Act, Police Station Khurja Dehat, District Bulandshahar on her furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;

entities.text: Police Station Khurja Dehat, District Bulandshahar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: ( b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
